journeys.name: Search and Apply for an Apprenticeship
journeys.description: A user searches for apprenticeship opportunities, views details, and applies by completing the application sections and submitting.

journeys.name: Manage Applications
journeys.description: A signed-in user views, deletes, or withdraws their existing apprenticeship applications.

journeys.name: Manage Account Settings
journeys.description: A signed-in user updates their settings such as personal details, notification preferences, and equality questions.

journeys.name: Delete Account
journeys.description: A user initiates, reviews, and confirms the deletion of their account.

journeys.name: Search for Apprenticeships by Interests
journeys.description: A user begins from job category interests to refine and start a location-based search.

journeys.name: Start a New Account Registration
journeys.description: A user begins account registration and completes the initial details before choosing account preferences.
